svg.title: OPTC weekly court timetable
svg.desc: A portrait weekly timetable for sharing. General court use is shown in daylight, subject to availability. Mixed social tennis Wednesday 7–9 pm and men's social tennis Thursday 6–8 pm are organised under lights. Members may use courts after dark but cannot turn on the lights.
svg.text: General court use and organised social tennis
Other times: courts may be used subject to availability, including after dark.
Members cannot turn on the lights, so general play after dark is unlit.
Lights are normally switched on for organised social tennis.
PLAY LOCAL • BUILD YOUR GAME • SHARE THE COURT
